remaining_gates: Scientific review of naming limits, layer and regional gate conventions.

name: Caribbean Current
scope: Selected westward Caribbean regional route from a Windward Islands approach to the Belize/Yucatan transition near 19 N. Excludes the northward Yucatan Current, Loop and Florida currents, additional island entry branches, Colombia-Panama gyre circuits and eddy perimeters. No unique continuous axis or whole-system length asserted.
layer: Near-surface regional geography; no fixed-depth velocity axis reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional convention informed by 1996-2001 near-surface drifter circulation; not a dated trajectory or extracted mean axis.
source_locator: Centurioni and Niiler (2003), sections 1-3 paragraphs 2, 4, 6-9 and section 4 paragraph 12: westward basins, Jamaica Ridge jets and transition into Yucatan Current; eddy-dominated mean-flow limitations.
source_citation: Centurioni and Niiler (2003), On the surface currents of the Caribbean Sea, Geophysical Research Letters 30, doi:10.1029/2002GL016231.
coordinate_selection: All vertices and terminal gates are OSW choices. Southern and northern corridor alternatives explore branch convention, not recovered drifter tracks. Stop at the regional transition rather than extending through the Yucatan Channel. Source Lagrangian decorrelation scales are not current lengths.
scenario_rule: Two corridor conventions crossed with three longitude and independent endpoint latitude shifts: 54 editorial scenarios, not statistical uncertainty.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Alternative northern regional corridor; not a simultaneous second branch to add to the nominal length.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 54 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
